    Old Town Barcelona Walk

    Barcelona, Spain  •  2.5 hours  •  Easy

    About This Tour

    Wander through the Gothic Quarter's medieval streets, discover hidden plazas, and taste authentic Catalan cuisine. This walking tour covers 2,000 years of Barcelona's history.

    Tour Highlights

    Gothic Quarter medieval architecture
    La Boqueria market food tasting
    Hidden Roman ruins
    Local tapas experience
